So, as you, random French person who bought my game and all you other readers may know, i have been struggling to get update V2 of Dionysus to work, but i finally was able to 100% fix it, i apologize so much for my difficulty to be a game dev and publisher.

notes.title: Dionysus First Update!
notes.content:
The first update

Hello fellow gamers! This is Catsle Studios telling you that Dionysus is getting its first update right now! This update will include the new Card Randomization feature, 2 new cards which include the slow enemies and plus one ball card. I will also throw in the new settings menu with the ability to adjust audio.

August Update

Next August I will release a poll for a new update so stay tuned!

Catsle Studios
